title: Clarity Upscaler
summary: Upscale an image with Clarity Upscaler
description: Clarity Upscaler — creative AI upscaling that can add detail as it enlarges, steered by creativity/resemblance controls and an optional guiding prompt. 30 credits per image (typically ~60 seconds).

creativity.description: How much new detail the model may invent (0.3-0.9 recommended).

dynamic.description: HDR effect strength (3-9 for best results).

image.description: Image to upscale. A public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

prompt.description: Optional guiding prompt describing the image content — helps the model invent plausible detail.

resemblance.description: How closely the result must match the input (0-3).

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results. Omit for random.
